entries.title: CoAgent: Concurrency Control for Multi-Agent Systems
entries.relationship: An adjacent advisory concurrency-control proposal reports serializability and workload results under its own assumptions. Its model, tool inverses and measurements have not been reproduced against Agent Braid's M2 Git path.
entries.decision: Proposed: retain as a research comparator; require a bounded semantics and artifact comparison before novelty or relative-performance claims. Founder decision pending.

entries.title: Position: Multi-Agent Systems Should Prioritize Concurrency Control
entries.sourceDate: arXiv page lists 2026-06-06, while identifier 2608 suggests 2026-08; discrepancy unresolved; accessed 2026-09-27
entries.relationship: An adjacent argumentative position argues for explicit concurrency control. The available unreproduced-result schema label is a conservative fallback, not a claim that this position reports an empirical result. It does not establish Agent Braid's correctness, demand, novelty or performance.
entries.decision: Proposed: retain only as problem-framing context, with no M2 evidence upgrade. Founder decision pending.

entries.title: Agent2Agent protocol specification
entries.relationship: Task, artifact and update-event identities could inform a future trace adapter, but protocol conformance alone cannot establish semantic independence or safe schedule exchange.
entries.decision: Proposed: keep version-pinned adapter and conformance evaluation outside M2 closure; no implementation adoption. Founder decision pending.

entries.title: Model Context Protocol security best practices
entries.relationship: Authorization, session, SSRF and local-server risks reinforce the existing boundary against external traces and write-capable adapters in the bounded M2 Git experiment.
entries.decision: M0.5 previously adopted these threat classes only as future adapter requirements. Proposed M2 disposition carries that narrow decision forward; no adapter or external execution is authorized. Founder M2 radar decision pending.
